method: SpCas9 cutting frequency determination (CFD), per-site score
citation: Doench et al. (2016), Optimized sgRNA design to maximize activity and minimize off-target effects of CRISPR-Cas9. Nature Biotechnology 34:184-191. doi:10.1038/nbt.3437

cfd.mm.scores.cas9.txt.key_convention: guide DNA + candidate DNA + 1-based position from guide 5-prime end

cfd.pam.scores.cas9.txt.key_convention: final two DNA bases of candidate PAM

redistribution.rationale: The repository explicitly licenses the project as a whole under MIT, with separately licensed underlying Python packages in inst/python. The CFD parameter tables and their process.R script are in inst/cfd_cas9; no separate CFD license or exclusion was present in the inspected tree. The original MIT notice is retained unchanged. This records the upstream distribution terms; the user-selected license for project-owned code is not used as permission for the tables.

reference_validation.procedure: Execute unchanged revcom/calc_cfd bodies from the Doench calculator distributed in CRISPOR, using its original tables from data-only deserialization. The Python 2 CLI is excluded. No offtargetpred.cfd implementation or crisprScore tables are used to generate expected values.
